package.description: A mod launcher for Command & Conquer Generals and Zero Hour

en-US.description: A mod launcher for Command & Conquer Generals and Zero Hour
en-US.longDescription: Install, switch between and start mods, patches, add-ons and executables for Command & Conquer Generals and Zero Hour. Mods come from their authors (their own pages, or direct links the authors published); your game folder is restored when the game closes.
en-US.name: GenLauncher
